name: Rachel Kim
personal_statement: I spent four years writing the flight software that keeps aircraft stable when the pilot cannot. Then I flew those aircraft to understand what I had built from the other side of the glass. I think in systems — how components interact, where dependencies create fragility, and how to design resilience into architectures that cannot be patched mid-flight. That is exactly the mindset a spacecraft needs.
psychological_profile: Technically strong, growth-oriented mindset. Scores well on adaptive reasoning tasks. Personal statement is clear and grounded — does not oversell. Physical and technical credentials are solid for this stage. A well-rounded candidate at the early career point of the experience curve.
